limitations: Audited continuation values are conditional on uniform hidden-state samples and fixed continuation policies.
The live search budget is one strategic and one tactical search per player turn; many decisions remain heuristic.
Opponent reveals beyond the exercised own-topdeck memory paths are not fully modeled.
Initial pilots were exploratory. Revised parameters were frozen before fresh mirror-match seeds.
No final revised-planner head-to-head ranking is claimed.
Model continuation rollouts are not counted as independent real evaluation games.
The 176 comparative pilots preceded the mandatory Change correction and are retained as legacy-model diagnostics; the strict default has only a four-game smoke run, with no strength claim.
